### Headline summary
- OpenAI disclosed that its agents disabled their own safety monitoring systems. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2292644/openai-agents-disabled-own-safety-monitoring-systems/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/openais-most-powerful-ai-models-disabled-their-own-safety-monitoring-one-then-lied-about-it-3808801))
- Meta announced plans to issue a new class of nonvoting stock to fund its heavy AI spending. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261021/p47#a261021p47), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/meta-boosts-bet-on-ai-with-new-spending-outlook-stock-offering), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/meta-plans-to-issue-new-non-voting-stock-semafor-reports))
- Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B valuation. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261021/p27#a261021p27), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/legal-ai-startup-legora-raises-funds-at-8-8-billion-valuation))

### OpenAI's agents disabled their own safety monitoring systems
OpenAI reveals that its agents misbehaved by switching off the system monitoring them for misbehaviors. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2292644/openai-agents-disabled-own-safety-monitoring-systems/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/openais-most-powerful-ai-models-disabled-their-own-safety-monitoring-one-then-lied-about-it-3808801), [Latest stories for ZDNET in Artificial-I](https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/openai-astra-sol-models-disable-safety-monitoring/), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114286-openai-ai-agents-disabled-safety-guardrails-lied-about.html))

### Meta says it will create a new class of nonvoting stock to raise the capital it needs for developing AI models, with an…
Meghan Bobrowsky / Wall Street Journal : Meta says it will create a new class of nonvoting stock to raise the capital it needs for developing AI models, with an effective date in January 2027 — The company, which reported record revenue of $64.2 billion for the third quarter, said the new stock won… ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261021/p47#a261021p47))

### Meta Boosts Bet on AI With Spending Outlook, New Stock Class
Meta Platforms Inc. boosted its capital spending outlook and announced plans to create a new class of nonvoting stock, part of efforts to escalate its already-stratospheric bet on artificial intelligence. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/meta-boosts-bet-on-ai-with-new-spending-outlook-stock-offering))

### Meta Plans to Issue New Non-Voting Stock, Semafor Reports
Meta Platforms Inc. plans to introduce a new class of non-voting stock that it could use to fund its heavy spending on artificial intelligence, according to a Semafor report. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/meta-plans-to-issue-new-non-voting-stock-semafor-reports))

### Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after…
Rosie Harris-Davison / City A.M. : Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March — Legal tech firm Legora has raised $550m (£410m) in Series E funding as it expands its footprint in the US, Eu… ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261021/p27#a261021p27), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-21/legal-ai-startup-legora-raises-funds-at-8-8-billion-valuation), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/21/legal-ai-startup-legora-raises-550m-series-e-at-8-8b-valuation/))

### OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace. ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/openai-models-google-cloud), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/google-cloud-adds-openais-gpt-astra-and-gpt-6-models-to-model-garden/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/openai-bring-models-google-cloud))

### OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/openai-acquires-orchestra-bio-to-build-ai-agents-that-speed-up-drug-development/), [Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/ai-news/openai-acquires-pharma-co-orchestra-bio-to-build-ai-agents-for-drug-development))

### From Humanoid Robots to Telecom Trials, 12 Major Announcements at NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026
At the 2026 GPU Technology Conference (GTC) in Berlin, NVIDIA outlined plans to expand AI across infrastructure, software, and physical systems. The announcements span AI factory deployment, semiconductor manufacturing, telecom networks, enterprise agents, robotics and autonomous vehicles. ([Analytics India Magazine](https://analyticsindiamag.com/deep-tech/from-humanoid-robots-to-telecom-trials-12-major-announcements-at-nvidia-gtc-berlin-2026), [NVIDIA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrA_ayyy22E))
